items.applies_to: nickel and iron in liquid lead
items.quote: The lead matrix samples were analysed using an Inductively Coupled Plasma (ICP) emission spectrometer: the solubility of nickel in liquid lead was analyzed with a Spectro Arcos Side on Plasma (SOP) instrument at Norilsk Nickel Harjavalta Oy, and the solubility of nickel and iron in liquid lead with a Thermo Scientific instrument at Outotec (Finland) Oy.
Trace analyses were carried out using a 25 kV accelerating voltage and a 500 nA beam current using galena (PbS) provided by Astimex as a lead standard.
